# InspirAI — AI-Powered Design Research for Coding Agents

> `refero-design-mcp` is an MCP server for discovering, searching and extracting
> design systems from the public pages of styles.refero.design.

The underlying data belongs to Refero Design. This is an unofficial client; no
affiliation or endorsement is implied.

- Canonical URL: [https://inspirai.os.darcas.app/](https://inspirai.os.darcas.app/)
- Package: `@darcas/refero-design-mcp` (MIT, requires Node ≥ 22.12)
- Install: `npm install -g @darcas/refero-design-mcp`
- Repository: [github.com/DarCas/refero-design-mcp](https://github.com/DarCas/refero-design-mcp)
- Full context in one fetch: [llms-full.txt](https://inspirai.os.darcas.app/llms-full.txt)
- Human-readable reference: [README](https://github.com/DarCas/refero-design-mcp#readme)

## The honest summary

- The JSON API is not used: `styles.refero.design/robots.txt` disallows `/api/`,
  and the endpoint answers `403` to non-browser clients. The server reads only
  what `Allow: /` permits — the published sitemap and the public style pages.
- Coverage is reported, never implied: the index grows on demand over 1,342
  published styles, so every search states its own coverage
  (`refero_index_status` exists so the model checks before concluding absence).
- Measured, not claimed: `refero_index_status` 27.9 ms → 0.15 ms (186×),
  cached `expand` scan 49.0 ms → 0.10 ms (490×), first call 372 ms → 70 ms
  (5.3×). Median of 15 runs, warm cache of 26 of 1,342 styles.

## The six tools

- `refero_index_status` — Published styles vs. locally indexed styles.
  ([Tools](https://inspirai.os.darcas.app/#tools))
- `refero_search_styles` — Free-text search over names, north stars, colours,
  fonts, URLs. ([Tools](https://inspirai.os.darcas.app/#tools))
- `refero_match_style` — Ranks styles against a prose design brief.
  ([Tools](https://inspirai.os.darcas.app/#tools))
- `refero_get_design_md` — Renders a style as `design.md`, by section
  (`overview · colors · typography · type_scale · spacing · surfaces · imagery ·
  principles · components · similar · custom`).
  ([Tools](https://inspirai.os.darcas.app/#tools))
- `refero_get_style` — Parsed design system plus measured tokens, as JSON.
  ([Tools](https://inspirai.os.darcas.app/#tools))
- `refero_list_style_ids` — Style UUIDs from the sitemap, without reading any
  page. ([Tools](https://inspirai.os.darcas.app/#tools))

## The skill

`refero-design-research` teaches a coding agent to do evidence-based design
research with this server before implementing UI. Install with
`refero-design-skill install`. It contains no Refero data — only instructions,
plus a tool reference generated from `src/`.
([The skill](https://inspirai.os.darcas.app/#skill))
